description: RSS and Atom reader: give a feed URL or any news site, blog, or podcast page and get its latest items as clean JSON: title, link, published date, author, a plain-text summary, and media (podcast audio) links. Finds the feed automatically from the page when needed. Useful for news monitoring, research digests, and tracking competitors or releases. Not charged if no feed is found or it can't be fetched. Paid via x402; see list_prices.
